verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm an llms.txt at docs.aws.amazon.com that gives structured access to AWS service documentation for LLMs. They also confirm SES docs pages are served as agent-friendly markdown (Welcome.html.md returns HTTP 200), so an agent can be pointed at either. Missing for 10: an SES-specific llms.txt (the file found is AWS-wide), first-party documentation describing these agent-oriented doc formats, and independent corroboration of agents using them for SES.
